import logging, sys
logging.basicConfig(stream=sys.stdout, level=logging.INFO,
                    format="%(levelname)s:%(message)s", force=True)
log = logging.getLogger("shop")

def total(prices):
    s = 0
    for p in prices:
        if p < 0:
            log.warning("skipping negative price %s", p)
            continue
        log.debug("adding %s", p)
        s += p
    log.info("total=%s", s)
    return s

total([5, -2, 7])
